architectural_units.name: Presentation Layer
architectural_units.description: Layer responsible for displaying information to the user, including web and mobile platforms.

architectural_units.name: Business Layer
architectural_units.description: Core layer responsible for processing information and user requests.

architectural_units.name: Data Layer
architectural_units.description: Layer responsible for storing all system data.

architectural_units.name: Web Platform
architectural_units.description: Web interface of the Waapiti platform.

architectural_units.name: Mobile Platform
architectural_units.description: Mobile interface of the Waapiti platform.

architectural_units.name: API Gateway
architectural_units.description: Service responsible for management, authentication, authorization, and routing of API requests.

architectural_units.name: Core
architectural_units.description: Central service responsible for business logic and database interaction.

architectural_units.name: Analytics Module
architectural_units.description: Service responsible for obtaining and processing playlogs, connections, and platform actions.

architectural_units.name: API Player
architectural_units.description: Service responsible for communicating with players to receive status and content information.

architectural_units.name: Web Socket
architectural_units.description: Service enabling bidirectional communication between the platform and players.

architectural_units.name: Database
architectural_units.description: Relational database for storing system data.

architectural_units.name: Cloud Services
architectural_units.description: Collection of AWS services forming a data lake for historical data processing.

architectural_units.name: MySQL
architectural_units.description: Database engine used for the relational database.

architectural_units.name: Amazon S3
architectural_units.description: Object storage service for JSON documents.

architectural_units.name: DynamoDB
architectural_units.description: NoSQL database service for real-time playlog storage.

architectural_units.name: Amazon Athena
architectural_units.description: Service for querying data stored in S3 using SQL.

architectural_units.name: AWS Glue
architectural_units.description: Data integration service used for metadata management and data cataloging.

architectural_units.name: Kinesis Data Streams
architectural_units.description: Service for real-time data streaming.

architectural_units.name: Kinesis Data Firehose
architectural_units.description: Service for loading streaming data into data stores.

architectural_units.name: Player
architectural_units.description: Miniature computer device connected to screens for content reproduction.

architectural_units.name: HTTP
architectural_units.description: Protocol used for communication between presentation and business layers.

architectural_units.name: TCP
architectural_units.description: Protocol used for communication between microservices.

architectural_units.name: NestJS
architectural_units.description: Backend framework used for developing microservices.

architectural_units.name: TypeScript
architectural_units.description: Programming language used for development.

architectural_units.name: SAT
architectural_units.description: Technical support department of Waapiti.

architectural_units.name: Product Owner
architectural_units.description: Stakeholder responsible for product value and requirements.

architectural_units.name: Developer
architectural_units.description: Author of the project responsible for design and implementation.

architectural_units.name: Clients
architectural_units.description: External beneficiaries of the platform.

patterns.name: Client-Server
patterns.description: The platform is a web service where the client makes requests to a server that processes them and returns the response.

patterns.name: Three Layers
patterns.description: The system is divided into three layers: presentation layer, business layer, and data layer.

patterns.name: Microservices
patterns.description: The business and data layers are divided into several different services to improve security, scalability, and availability.

patterns.name: API Gateway
patterns.description: A design pattern that allows only one component to interact between users and the services provided by the platform, handling authorization and SSL.

patterns.name: Data Lake
patterns.description: A centralized repository that allows for the storage of structured and unstructured data at any scale without needing to modify or structure it initially.
